This change aims to address an issue related to undefined bitwise shift behavior, suggesting that the new function may handle edge cases or specific conditions more effectively than the previous implementation. The consistent replacement across multiple functions indicates that the bit shift calculation is a common operation in the driver, and the update improves the overall reliability and maintainability of the code.
